title: API Client Configuration Generator
description: Generate or extend lib/config/client.ts with a named, configured ApiClient. Run it again with another name to add more clients to the same file. Auto-invoked by the action generator.

name.description: Name of the API client, exported from lib/config/client.ts (e.g. api, payments, search). The first client in a project is also the file's default export. Default: api

projectName.description: Target project name where lib/config/client.ts is generated. Required (or set it as this generator's default in nx.json); the prompt lists existing projects; pass a new name with -p to create it as a feature library.
projectName.x-prompt: Which project should the client config be generated in?

envVar.description: Env var holding this client's base URL, registered in .env/.env.example and lib/config/env.ts. Default: <PROJECT>_API_URL for the default client (api), <NAME>_API_URL otherwise

clientPackage.description: API client package to import from. Use @next-feature/client (default) or custom package like @myorg/api-client

baseUrl.description: Deprecated and ignored: each client reads its base URL from its env var (see envVar)
baseUrl.x-deprecated: Ignored: each client reads its base URL from its env var (see envVar).

includeInterceptors.description: Deprecated and ignored: the generated file has no interceptor examples
includeInterceptors.x-deprecated: Ignored: the generated file has no interceptor examples; see the client-config README.

skipFormat.description: Skip prettier code formatting (used internally for chained generators)

export.description: Export the clients from the library's server.ts so other projects can reuse them (ignored for applications)
